data.title: The bundle carries its own copy of the okf-yaml generator, schema and templates
data.description: The adr skill's renderer is vendored into adrs/ and run by uv, so the bundle renders from a clone alone

data.title: Every policy reads the mdast tree the remark host already parsed
data.description: The adapter hands the host's own tree to createDocument, and only string callers parse, once, with the shared parser

data.title: Whole-document data is derived once per round on a shared DocumentContext
data.description: Every enabled policy in a reporting round reads one DocumentContext, so derived data is computed once and agrees

data.title: Paragraph and text nodes carry a language view that analyses on first read
data.description: node.data.language exposes projected text at once and one memoised sentence Promise only when a rule asks for it

data.title: A project's CONCEPTS.md supplies the term names the language view tags as nouns
data.description: Each defined heading in CONCEPTS.md in the working directory becomes a literal noun phrase for that context's sentences

data.title: Configuration is remark plugin options, and a disabled policy never runs
data.description: Policies are switched and tuned through the plugin's options in the host's remark config, with no config file of its own

data.title: A custom policy's finding is a fatal error, or the policy is off
data.description: Custom severities accept only error or off, and a Mermaid diagram that cannot be evaluated is an error too

data.title: A policy identifier is its subsystem, then a category word and a short name
data.description: Identifiers read subsystem/category-short-name, such as prose/sentence-one-per-line, never a number

data.title: Each policy lives in its own module named by its short name
data.description: A prose policy is one file under src/prose/rules that returns diagnostics with any edit, listed in one registry

data.title: Shared code sits in the layer whose data it takes, and layers import downwards
data.description: src/document takes source and trees and imports no policy, and policies import the document layer, never the reverse

data.title: Code complexity is gated by Biome rules that fail the build
data.description: Every Biome complexity rule runs at error, with cognitive complexity capped at 10, and bun run check fails past it

data.title: Fixes splice source ranges and the adapter never stringifies the tree
data.description: An edit replaces a source range, the compiler returns the edited source, and rounds repeat until no edit remains

data.title: A fixer offers no edit whenever the input is ambiguous
data.description: An unfixable case leaves the source untouched and the finding reported, never a best guess

data.title: Every edit is reparsed and compared with the original before a finding may carry it
data.description: An edit that changes visible words or structure beyond its declared change is withdrawn, alone and as a batch

data.title: An edit is applied only through a visible finding of a fixable policy
data.description: A fix travels on the diagnostic its check reports, so a passing or suppressed passage is never rewritten

data.title: Fix behaviour is proven by real-input tests of edits, refusals and stability
data.description: A fixer change is tested for its edit, untouched bytes, refusals, recheck and idempotence, with no mocks

data.title: Sentence and paragraph budget findings are reported and never autofixed
data.description: The word and sentence budget policies have no fixer, because shortening or breaking prose is a decision about meaning

data.title: A sentence budget finding estimates clauses to guide a split
data.description: The clause count is the larger of marker words and Compromise verbs, and the message names a target sentence count

data.title: A paragraph budget finding suggests breaks from lexical cohesion
data.description: Paragraphs over the sentence budget report topic groups, break points and content terms per sentence

data.title: An em-dash pair becomes parentheses and a lone em-dash becomes a colon
data.description: punctuation-em-dash-in-prose rewrites only the two dash shapes whose replacement punctuation is unambiguous

data.title: A comma-joined run of three or more inline code spans is a hidden list
data.description: list-comma-code-run flags the run anywhere, and its fix promotes it only when it closes a sentence after a lead-in

data.title: Every diagram is read through Mermaid's own parsers, never by scanning its text
data.description: Mermaid policies take nodes, edges, styles and shapes from Mermaid core and @mermaid-js/parser results

data.title: A diagram is a mermaid code node of the host's tree, mapped back to the source by line
data.description: Fences come from the mdast tree the remark host supplies, and findings map to absolute Markdown offsets

data.title: Where Mermaid exposes nothing, the narrowest workaround is used and refuses when it would guess
data.description: Source alignment, the zenuml detector and declaration reading are small workarounds that place only what is certain

data.title: Colour parsing, compositing and WCAG contrast come only from colorjs.io
data.description: No hand-written colour parser, luminance formula, alpha blend or contrast ratio

data.title: Theme colours come from Mermaid's own theme engine on a pinned Mermaid version
data.description: Both light and dark theme variables are resolved by Mermaid itself, never copied into the package

data.title: The page canvas is a contrast rule option that defaults to GitHub's light and dark pages
data.description: Page-backed surfaces are scored on an opaque canvas.light and canvas.dark the host may set

data.title: Styling the contrast audit cannot model is reported as an error, never scored by a guess
data.description: Custom themeCSS, unsupported modes and unmodelled surfaces report unauditable instead of passing silently

data.title: Complexity thresholds are remark rule options, never environment variables
data.description: A density preset and numeric overrides come only from the plugin options a remark configuration commits

data.title: The visual complexity score counts what a reader must read, not every record the parser keeps
data.description: Markers, notes and control lines are left out, and boxes, blocks and attribute rows are counted

data.title: Mermaid policies report findings with guidance and never edit a diagram
data.description: Contrast and complexity expose no fix, and a split plan is a recommendation a human applies

data.title: A split plan is offered only after an independent contract and a reparse of every emitted source
data.description: The verifier recomputes the expected facts and parses each overview and detail again with Mermaid's parsers

data.title: A split plan folds the author's own structure first and refuses what it cannot draw faithfully
data.description: Author regions, decision regions, aggregates, echoing regions and twin lanes fold whole, and concurrency is refused

data.title: A dense mesh or an unsorted star gets no plan, and the finding offers the matrix or list that reads better
data.description: Shapes no fold can summarise are refused with a reason and a list or matrix built from the whole graph

data.title: A split plan makes the fewest folds that meet its target, keeps groups even, and says why it was flagged
data.description: Rows drop before nodes fold, overviews stay above an even floor, and each plan states its measured size and target

data.title: Label families the author wrote keep a suggested group to one family under the strict rules
data.description: Dotted namespaces, id prefixes and shared status stems are read as the author's grouping and are not mixed first

data.title: A split plan names each group by what it holds, never by one arbitrary member
data.description: Regions, heads, families, lanes, ranges, fans, spans and member lists name a group before any single member does

data.title: A detail's stub text has exactly one reading, and each edge it stands for is drawn once
data.description: Stubs name their group as the overview shows it, share a box in flowcharts, and never repeat an edge

data.title: A long plain-word run is a hidden list, and every run rule takes a minItems option
data.description: list-comma-plain-run reports plain series from five items, and minItems sets each run rule's threshold

data.title: The MkDocs site includes canonical reference documents at build time
data.description: Task guides live in docs-site, while a build hook exposes the existing reference documents without duplicate sources

data.title: The standalone CLI runs the native remark engine with explicit write controls
data.description: A scoped binary supplies the remark engine, default policies and verified source edits
